## Improvements and fixes

- Fixed receiving SMS and MMS from five- and six-digit short codes through Sinch and Bandwidth. Sender codes, including leading zeros, are preserved for message history and forwarding.
- Fixed outbound fax results arriving without the account and fax details needed to update delivery status and schedule retries.
- Outbound faxes now finish trying fallback gateways before reporting a routing failure, preventing premature retries and duplicate failure reports. Failure details retain the last gateway's rejection reason.
- Fixed outbound fax calls losing parts of their configured codec list or fax header when values contain commas.
- Email delivery failures now produce concise log entries with clear error categories and available job details. Duplicate reports and lengthy stack traces are suppressed for mail transport errors, while existing retry behavior and failed-job reporting are preserved.
